name: Touchtry-JwelAR
author: touchtry

sections.description:
Touchtry JwelAR is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates Augmented Reality (AR) try-on functionality into your WooCommerce store. This plugin allows your customers to virtually try on jewelry products in real-time using their device’s camera, enhancing their shopping experience and reducing return rates.

Key Features:

  • Virtual Try-On: Let customers see how jewelry looks on them from anywhere.
  • Easy Integration: Simple setup with your WooCommerce products.
  • Dedicated AR Link Field: Add a unique AR try-on link per product.
  • Shop Page Hover Button: Display a “Try On” button on product images when hovered.
  • Single Product Page Button: Prominent “Virtual Try On” button on product pages.
  • Customizable Styling: Easily control button appearance via CSS.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: Includes guidance on GLB uploads, API integration, and pricing.

How it Works:

  1. Install & Activate: Upload and activate the plugin on your WordPress website.
  2. Add AR Links: Use the new “AR Try-On Link” field in the WooCommerce product editor.
  3. Upload GLB Models: Upload your 3D GLB files and matching transparent images to your Touchtry Dashboard.
  4. Customer Experience:
    • On shop pages, a “Try On” button appears on hover.
    • On single product pages, a “Virtual Try On” button is displayed near the Add to Cart section.
    • Clicking the button launches the live AR try-on view.

Requirements:

  • WooCommerce Plugin (active).
  • A Touchtry account and your product-specific AR links.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:
    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Choose touchtry-jwelar.zip and click “Install Now”.
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • Click Activate Plugin after installation.
  3. Configure the Plugin:
    • Visit the JwelAR menu in the admin sidebar.
    • Follow the dashboard instructions for uploading GLB files and setting AR links.
sections.faq:
Where do I get the AR Try-On Link?

You can generate these from your Touchtry Dashboard after uploading your 3D models and assets.

Is this plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

It uses standard WooCommerce hooks, making it broadly compatible. Minor styling adjustments may be needed with custom themes.

How can I change button positions or appearance?

Modify .jwlear-single-button and .jwlear-shop-button classes via plugin CSS or your theme’s custom CSS panel.

Is a free trial available?

Yes, a 7-day free trial is available for all new Touchtry users.
